chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'd narrated to us, saying: Fadalah narrated to us from al-Qasim ibn Burayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim

He said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the inmates of Hell, so he said: My father Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to say: They will come out from it and will be taken to a spring at the gate of Paradise called the Spring of Life. They will then be showered with its water, and their flesh, skin, and hair will grow back just as plants grow.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the inhabitants of Hell after their punishment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted via Muhammad ibn Muslim, elucidates the intermediate stage of release for the monotheistic sinners punished in Hell, highlighting the miraculous regeneration of their bodies at 'Ayn al-Hayawan'. This process serves as a physical purification and restoration prior to their final entry into Paradise, reflecting the Shia understanding of *Khuruj Ahl al-Tawhid min al-Nar* (the exit of the people of monotheism from the Fire). The imagery of regrowth like crops underscores the divine power to restore what was consumed by fire, affirming the temporary nature of their punishment.
